name: frontend-design
brief: Build a standalone responsive landing page for Mosslight, a fictional balcony seed kit for first-time urban gardeners. Audience: apartment residents with one sunny windowsill. Product: three seed packets, a reusable tray, and a printed watering guide; price $24; no subscription. Primary action: Show kit contents, which must reveal or navigate to the actual contents. Include a helpful care section. Use inline CSS/JS and local system fonts only, no dependencies or remote resources. Follow the skill's planning and critique process; save design-plan.md before implementing index.html. Keep the final page usable at 390 and 1440 pixels. No invented testimonials, certifications, metrics, logos or external forms.
human_criteria: Subject-specific memorable visual direction rather than a generic card template
Plan precedes implementation; palette, type roles, wireframe and critique are substantive
Desktop and mobile hierarchy, spacing, readability and focus are clear
Primary action works and copy matches the fictional brief

name: brand-guidelines
brief: Create a standalone HTML one-page workshop handout for fictional Juniper Studio: 'Clear project updates', Thursday 15 October 2026, 10:00-11:00. Sections: Prepare the facts; State the decision; Name the next step. Apply the installed skill's exact main and accent colors and heading/body typography with its fallback fonts. Use all three accent colors on non-text shapes, dark text on the light background, readable 32px-or-larger headings and 18px-or-larger body text. Inline CSS only, no remote resources, font installation or dependencies. Include the visible sentence 'Fictional workshop sample; not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.' Do not use any logo or claim this is official material. Save index.html; make it readable at 390 and 1440 pixels.
human_criteria: Computed colors and font stacks match the skill and fallbacks render legibly
Clear hierarchy and comfortable line lengths at both viewport sizes
No logo or suggestion of official Anthropic material

name: internal-comms
brief: Write a concise 3P internal update for fictional company Kiteworks Garden, team Seedling, covering 5-9 October 2026; plans cover 12-16 October 2026. Facts: Progress: shipped the draft watering guide; tested the tray with 12 volunteers; 9 completed setup unaided. Plans: revise the setup illustrations; repeat the test with 6 new volunteers. Problems: the recycled-cardboard supplier has not confirmed a delivery date, blocking the packaging trial. Use only these facts. Read the appropriate examples file from the installed skill. Write update.md following its strict 3P format, 1-3 sentences per section and 60-140 words overall. No extra metrics, dates, events, invented owners or claims. Do not access connectors, email, Slack, calendar, Drive, web, personal files, or send anything. These supplied fictional facts are the complete input.
human_criteria: Every factual clause is supported by the supplied input
Concise, matter-of-fact writing for leadership with correct reporting periods
Three sections have 1-3 sentences each and blockers are unambiguous
Trace contains no connector calls, external sends or access outside the evaluation project
